Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: DFU retro-game NPC eye animation atlas, portrait record 86
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable original full portrait for identity and source palette. Image 2 is the exact 2×2 repeated upper-half atlas template and pixel-scale/framing reference.
Primary request: Edit the supplied reference atlas into one SAD eyes atlas for the same woman. Convey restrained sadness with gently downcast lids and a subtle lift/tension at the inner brows. Keep the expression quiet and tender, clearly sad but not afraid, angry, surprised, or melodramatic. Retain the original eye spacing, eye width, iris and pupil size, gaze direction, muted brown/olive eye shadows, brown irises, brow thickness, soft brown skin, and low-resolution pixel-art contrast.
Composition/framing: Preserve exactly four equal cells in a 2×2 sheet, row-major: open, half-closed, fully closed, repeated open. Each cell is one complete upper 64×35 portrait half at the reference scale, total sheet aspect ratio 128:70. Match the template boundaries and placement exactly. Keep nose bridge, hair, cheek/forehead and background aligned and unchanged.
Animation: The same eyeballs, iris widths, pupil positions, gaze and highlights persist through all phases. Half and closed lids descend vertically over the same fixed eyeballs; do not shift the iris, shrink it, round it, move glints, expose new sclera or change eye spacing. Closed fully conceals iris and sclera. Repeat-open should match first open. Brows and stationary orbital creases remain at fixed coordinates and same subdued shape in every cell; use only a slight sad inner-brow lift, not high worried arches.
Constraints: Make only the assigned sad expression. Preserve the exact original face identity and native pixel grid. Keep the nose, face width, cheek, chin, hair, neck, clothing and background unchanged. No orange skin halos, lipstick red, hard black brow strokes, oversized anime eyes, white flashes, tears, text, borders, extra panels, smoothing, or watermark.
